description: This file defines a dialog plugin for CKEditor named 'pastetext', which provides a UI for pasting text into the editor. It sets up dialog content, event handlers, and interactions related to pasting text.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog content when the dialog is shown.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the event when the user accepts the paste operation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the textarea content when the dialog content is loaded.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Saves the pasted content and triggers a 'paste' event with the text.
